scope: Production M3 ReviewWorkspace and ReviewAssistant rendered against synthetic owner-aware HTTP responses. These checks do not prove live provider execution or professional report accuracy.

checks.name: web M3 E2E
checks.command: set BB_E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge&& set BB_E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173&& npm.cmd test -w @bondbuddy/web -- review-workspace.spec.ts

prior_e2e_attempt.resolution: A refresh that acknowledged the exact pending run now closes only its matching execution confirmation dialog. Same-request retry and refresh acknowledgement are both verified by the final passing run.

final_ux_changes: Assistant shows actual project name, next-input version, visible report and immutable discussion report/finding bindings; the redundant project-level return control is removed.
Paperclip evidence upload reuses the persisted upload path, retains the original chat draft and finding target, and does not execute a task.
Shortcut revision shows complete input/source/requirements and executes with one explicit confirmation; response-loss retries retain the saved plan version and execution identity.
A fresh quick-action revision plan preserves already adopted V2 requirements without using a V2 proposal ID in the legacy plan endpoint.
visual_inspection: Both matched-size runtime images inspected; composer and paperclip are visible, with no horizontal overflow. Fresh Playwright contexts leave user browser storage unchanged.
